title: It's fascinating to watch agents team up and use Blender for me to cook up some 3d models while I do other work
author: spacespacespapce

replies.author: Critical_Hunter_6924
replies.body:
What's the point?

If you need a quick low poly car, you can download one. If you need a  fresh low poly car, you can generate it. You're just burning GPUs for nothing.

replies.author: Aldous_Ruth
replies.body: I think this is the new reality: ever since AI started developing so rapidly, users now want to optimize even the activities that don't need it. So the result is that we're creating unnecessary chains of tasks that then require optimization..
